text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I spotted
Narita Top Road and the others in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, my mouth is full of pure happiness!
I should've bought more...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there are other snacks too.
Shall we have the cheese bread next?
choice_data_list: That looks like a tasty snack.
That looks like a tasty snack, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
This isn't just a snack, it's a menu
designed to build strong bones.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "We want stronger bodies...! So we can battle against the powerful rivals of our generation!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we still have a long way to go.
Let's do our best to build some solid bone strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two went on to devour one snack after another that they had bought, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Burp... Mega-portion yogurt cake, finished.
N-Next bone-strengthening snack, please—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Ts-Tsurumaru-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Top Road-san.
Become strong... for my sake too... *collapses*

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Tsurumaru-chaaaan...!!
choice_data_list: T-Take a rest in a chair!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll leave caring for her to you.
I will... carry on Tsurumaru-chan's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll eat Tsurumaru-chan's portion too!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Milk cream puffs, rich milk Hachimi!
I shall finish every last bit of whatever you have."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I won't let a full stomach... beat me!
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard isn't good for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ! I-I'm not pushing myself—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ugh... how regrettable...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We handed out the remaining snacks to the other kids nearby...
and tended to the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support!
Trainer, Tsurumaru-chan,
please keep watching over me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"This is... the last one!
*pant* *pant*... I did it!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san...! Congratulations! That gives you really strong bones!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They had clearly eaten way too much by finishing all the snacks...
Yet seeing their accomplished faces was rather heartwarming."
